title: HDL cholesterol

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: HDL stands for high-density lipoprotein, often called the good cholesterol. HDL helps get rid of LDL (the bad) cholesterol, and a higher HDL level may help reduce the risk of heart attack or stroke.
context: HDL is measured as part of a cholesterol test, which may need fasting for 9 to 12 hours beforehand. For HDL, higher levels are generally good for heart health, so a high HDL is not treated as a concern.
aboveRange: For HDL, a higher level is generally good for heart health and is not a problem
belowRange: Smoking can lower HDL, especially in women
Excess weight and a lack of physical activity can be associated with a lower HDL
A low HDL can be associated with a higher risk of heart problems
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
